name: Mynah
author: ReidenXerx
description: Voice dictation on a key, for the window you are already in. Press SUPER+ALT+D and talk: each time you pause, that sentence is transcribed on your own machine and typed into whatever has focus. A bird in the bar shows what it is doing and a pill shows your voice while it listens. Needs the mynah CLI and whisper.cpp; nothing is uploaded and there is no account.

barWidget.description: Dictation you can see: the bird lights up while it listens, and your level moves with your voice
